info.title: Turn A Gundam
info.synopsis: L'opera ha dietro di sé una storia piuttosto particolare che merita di essere quanto meno accennata. Nel 1999 la Sunrise, ed in particolare il franchise di Gundam, attraversavano un delicato momento. Erano appena stati archiviati: - Un fiasco commerciale ovvero Gundam X. - Un trionfo commerciale ovvero il film di Gundam Wing/Endless Waltz. - Un trionfo di critica/pubblico con la conclusione della serie OAV 08thMS Team. l'unica cosa che accomunava queste 3 produzioni era il fatto che il maestro Yoshiyuki Tomino, creatore di Gundam, non era stato minimamente coinvolto nella loro realizzazione. Con il prepararsi del ventennale della nascita di Gundam, la Sunrise decise di fare le cose in grande e ha richiamato Tomino alla direzione di una nuova serie Gundam. Il maestro ha avuto praticamente carta bianca e ha reinventato un Gundam assolutamente inedito pur citando in moltissimi punti le altre serie. In primis è la prima serie non UC fatta da Tomino e il nome ne è sintomatico dal momento che il simbolo della A rovesciata (Turn A appunto) significa, per chi non è particolarmente avvezzo a simboli matematici, "per ogni". Il titolo vero e proprio in effetti dovrebbe essere "Per ogni Gundam". TAG è, in teoria, la serie che le riassume tutte quante, presenti, passate e future. E' ambientata in un futuro lontanissimo dove la terra e la sua gente hanno attraversato un periodo del quale non si ha più memoria denominato 'L'età oscura'. Da non molto la civiltà si è risvegliata dal suo torpore e capisce di essere all'alba di una nuova era: una nuova rivoluzione industriale. Eh sì perché il livello di tecnologia/civiltà in cui vivono i terrestri nell'anno 2345 CC (anno di ambientazione della serie) è più o meno quello della terra dei primi del '900. Il problema è che i terrestri si sono dimenticati del fatto che sulla luna sono rimasti, e nel frattempo evoluti, moltissimi altri terrestri che hanno viceversa mantenuto una tecnologia avanzatissima. I moonrace hanno deciso che è giunto il momento di valutare un possibile ritorno sulla terra e mandano, quasi come se fossero delle cavie, tre ragazzini in esplorazione. Il loro compito è quello di mescolarsi con la gente comune e rendersi conto se è possibile un ritorno pacifico degli esuli lunariani sulla terra.

episodes.title: Howling at the Moon
episodes.synopsis: Loran lands on Earth and begins working for a wealthy family as their driver. Meanwhile, he meets up with his fellow comrades and discusses their plans.

episodes.title: After The Ceremony
episodes.synopsis: The Moon Race's attacks continue. Guin orders the area around Vicinity City to be excavated to find more mobile suits. Meanwhile, Loran's conflicted with being part of the Moonrace while on Earth.

episodes.title: The Advent of Dianna
episodes.synopsis: After attacking the Moonrace, Miashei is captured by Dianna Counter pilot Poe Aijee. Sochie and Kihel's mother starts acting strangely upon their return home. Harry and Guin continue negotiations. Moonrace queen Dianna Soriel arrives on the ship Soleil.

episodes.title: Training To Be A Lady
episodes.synopsis: Dianna hopes to reduce hostilities by holding a party between Inglessia and the Moonrace. Guin and Kihel have Loran cross dress as "Laura Rolla" to makes the Moonrace think the Turn A Gundam's pilot is a woman. Guin and Dianna agree to restart negotiations.

episodes.title: Corin Called It "Gundam"
episodes.synopsis: Moonrace criminal Corin Nander is released from cryogenic stasis and brought to Earth. Loran's identity as a Moonrace has become more public due to Fran's reporting. Sochie is skeptical of Loran and hopes to learn to pilot the Turn A Gundam instead.

episodes.title: The Destruction of Nocis
episodes.synopsis: The Militia grows restless, but Guin doesn't want to break the ceasefire and Corin wants the Moonrace to launch their own attack. Miran plots to head to the Sunbelt zone without Dianna's permission. Kihel (Dianna) seeks to negotiate and asks Loran to help.

episodes.title: An Older Person
episodes.synopsis: Kihel (Dianna) encounters a local man, Will Game, who is the grandson of her fiance from when she was previously on Earth decades before. Will is digging up what he believes to be a spaceship. Teteth confronts Loran on why he is helping the Militia.

episodes.title: Memories, Disappear
episodes.synopsis: Excavation continues on the spaceship, which Sid hopes to keep secret from Luziana. Will meets Dianna (Kihel) and is brought into the Dianna Counter forces. Will and Poe fight the Suicide Squad and Militia forces. Sochie joins in, piloting the Turn A Gundam.

episodes.title: Dust Blows On The Founding Of A Nation
episodes.synopsis: Dianna (Kihel) sends Guin a letter inviting him to the Moonrace's declaration of a nation in the Sunbelt Zone. The Militia starts recruiting Moonrace technicians to join them. Teteth plans to assassinate Dianna.

episodes.title: Sochie's War
episodes.synopsis: Work continues on the space ship discovered by Will Game, and a Gallop craft is discovered, which Loran is declared captain of. Dianna (Kihel) talks with Harry about those who disagree with her policies, including Agrippa Maintainer.

episodes.title: Dianna's Desperate Fight
episodes.synopsis: Bruno and Jacop join the Gallop, hoping to steal the Turn A Gundam. Dianna (Kihel) discusses Agrippa Maintainer's possible betrayal with Miran and Harry. Lily suggests Kihel (Dianna) help at the local hospital and she directly encounters the anguish the fighting has caused.

episodes.title: Teteth's Last Words
episodes.synopsis: Teteth meets up with another undercover Moonrace, Meme Midgard about her observations of the Turn A Gundam. Gavane asks Sochie to marry him. Kihel (Dianna) recognizes Midgard. Teteth finds Corin Nander, but he only freaks out upon seeing the Turn A Gundam. Archaeologist assistant Joseph Yaht meets Loran's friend Fran. Teteth manipulates a man named Troy to trick Loran and capture the Turn A Gundam. She also captures Dianna, but exchanges her for weapons. Loran uses the Gallop to trick Teteth and take back the Turn A Gundam. Midgard kills Teteth.

episodes.title: Willgem Takes Off
episodes.synopsis: Work concludes on the Willghem. Kihel (Dianna) has headed off with Corin Nander and Loran follows in the Turn A Gundam. She realizes the effect the Moonrace's arrival has had on the local populace. Gavane gives Sochie her wedding dress. Dianna Counter's Phil Ackman hopes to destroy the Willghem, but Dianna (Kihel) says to capture it instead. Loran encounters Fran and Keith. The Willghem successfully takes off and escapes the Dianna Counter attack.

episodes.title: Seperated, Again
episodes.synopsis: Loran assists with the excavation of the spaceship. Luziana military commander Mulligan introduces the Militia, including Sochie, to the Suicide Squad, led by Gavane Goonny. Miran recommends Dianna declare a Moonrace nation in the Sunbelt zone.

episodes.title: The Dissapearing Memory
episodes.synopsis: Excavation continues on the spaceship, which Sid hopes to keep secret from Luziana. Will meets Dianna (Kihel) and is brought into the Dianna Counter forces. Will and Poe fight the Suicide Squad and Militia forces. Sochie joins in, piloting the Turn A Gundam.

episodes.title: All About "Turn A Gundam"
episodes.synopsis: A recap episode. Loran summarizes the events of the first 15 episodes.

episodes.title: Blowing Dust for the Founding of a Nation
episodes.synopsis: Dianna (Kihel) sends Guin a letter inviting him to the Moonrace's declaration of a nation in the Sunbelt Zone. The Militia starts recruiting Moonrace technicians to join them. Teteth plans to assassinate Dianna.

episodes.title: Kiel and Dianna
episodes.synopsis: Kihel (Dianna) reveals her true identity to Loran, thinking her counterpart's life is in danger. The Militia launches an attack on the Moonrace forces and Teteth attempts again to kill Dianna. Dianna (Kihel) makes her founding of the state proclamation.

episodes.title: Sochie`s War
episodes.synopsis: Work continues on the space ship discovered by Will Game, and a Gallop craft is discovered, which Loran is declared captain of. Dianna (Kihel) talks with Harry about those who disagree with her policies, including Agrippa Maintainer.

episodes.title: Anis` Power
episodes.synopsis: The Suicide Squad is forced to retreat from the Dianna Counter's mobile suits. Loran meets an old woman, Anise Bell. The Red Team, a group of Moonrace who have long been on Earth, attack, hoping to be accepted into Dianna Counter.

episodes.title: Dianna`s Struggle
episodes.synopsis: Bruno and Jacop join the Gallop, hoping to steal the Turn A Gundam. Dianna (Kihel) discusses Agrippa Maintainer's possible betrayal with Miran and Harry. Lily suggests Kihel (Dianna) help at the local hospital and she directly encounters the anguish the fighting has caused.

episodes.title: Harry`s Disaster
episodes.synopsis: The Moonrace leadership discusses the effect escaping settlers is having. Harry heads out wearing civilian clothing and sneaks in with some settlers, making it to the Militia's excavation site. Successful tests are performed on the space ship. Harry finds Kihel (Dianna), but she refuses to leave. Poe launches an attack, but she is forced to retreat by Loran and Harry. Guin proclaims the space ship to be called the Willghem.

episodes.title: The Last Words of Teteth
episodes.synopsis: Teteth meets up with another undercover Moonrace, Meme Midgard about her observations of the Turn A Gundam. Gavane asks Sochie to marry him. Kihel (Dianna) recognizes Midgard. Teteth finds Corin Nander, but he only freaks out upon seeing the Turn A Gundam. Archaeologist assistant Joseph Yaht meets Loran's friend Fran. Teteth manipulates a man named Troy to trick Loran and capture the Turn A Gundam. She also captures Dianna, but exchanges her for weapons. Loran uses the Gallop to trick Teteth and take back the Turn A Gundam. Midgard kills Teteth.

episodes.title: Laura`s Long Cry
episodes.synopsis: The Red Team and Suicide Squad battle. The Red Team later fights with Poe over repair shortages. Gavane and Sochie's engagement becomes public knowledge. The Red Team demands the Turn A Gundam's pilot fight them and attacks the local hospital. Joseph and Loran join up with the Suicide Squad to fight them off. Kihel (Dianna) realizes the Red Team are the descendants of Moonrace troops left behind decades later. She desires to return to the Moon in order to stop the war.

episodes.title: Willgem`s Take-Off
episodes.synopsis: Work concludes on the Willghem. Kihel (Dianna) has headed off with Corin Nander and Loran follows in the Turn A Gundam. She realizes the effect the Moonrace's arrival has had on the local populace. Gavane gives Sochie her wedding dress. Dianna Counter's Phil Ackman hopes to destroy the Willghem, but Dianna (Kihel) says to capture it instead. Loran encounters Fran and Keith. The Willghem successfully takes off and escapes the Dianna Counter attack.

episodes.title: To be Awakened
episodes.synopsis: Kihel (Dianna) and Corin stop by at a nearby village. A mountain is discovered which may contain more mobile suits and both sides decide to go after it. One of Harry's underlings reports to him the sighting of Dianna and Corin. Loran finds them. Dianna hopes to use the Sacktrager space route to return to the moon. The village holds an Earth/Moonrace celebration which includes a float of the Turn A Gundam. Corin sees it and attacks it. Harry arrives. They trick Corin into thinking he defeated the real Turn A Gundam, and he leaves.

episodes.title: Sunrise at Midnight
episodes.synopsis: Kihel (Dianna) and Loran convince Harry to do some farming so as to experience what is like to be on Earth. The two later leave together. The Suicide Squad reaches the mountain, where the Moonrace is excavating mobile suits. A Moonrace officer, Ralfa, discovers that the mountain contains several nuclear weapons. Dianna and Kihel reunite and switch back to their original places. Dianna and Harry convince Kihel to stay with them. The Gallop and Red Team also rush towards the mountain. Ralfa's pleas for the fighting to stop are ignored. Gavane takes several nuclear bombs with him and fights with the Red Team. The nuclear bombs detonate, lighting up the sky for miles around.

episodes.title: Entrusted Things
episodes.synopsis: The Militia and Dianna Counter react to the nuclear explosion. Phil orders Poe to acquire the remaining nuclear bombs. Poe demands Ralfa hand over the 2 nuclear bombs he possesses causing him to flee to the Turn A Gundam and Gallop to ask for help. Ralfa gives the bombs to Loran, who places them in the Turn A Gundam's chest, with the goal to bury them or throw them in the ocean. Dianna and Phil argue over what to do. Ralfa brings Sochie and Miashei to the Soleil causing a battle during which he dies. Phil holds Dianna at gun point and Kihel escapes with Harry, trying to trick him into thinking she's Dianna.

episodes.title: The Two Diannas
episodes.synopsis: Miran helps Dianna onto a shuttle that departs the Soleil and meets up with Midgard. The Willghem crew argue over whether Kihel is Dianna. Sochie acts strangely, heading out on her Kapool in her wedding dress. Loran catches up to her and she calls out to Gavane. The Red Team desires to protect Dianna and attack the Willghem. Guin gets them to leave by pointing a gun at Kihel.

episodes.title: Holding you in my Arms
episodes.synopsis: Phil makes a speech to Dianna Counter. Dianna and Midgard depart from Ameria on a ship. A sick Poe searches for the Willghem. Harry confronts her and gives her medicine. The Red Team spots Dianna. The Willghem flies into the clouds since the Moonrace is afraid of lightning. Cancer and Muron of the Red Team catch up to Midgard and Dianna and they head to the ship Gendarme. Loran and the others fight off Poe.

episodes.title: Holding you in my Arms
episodes.synopsis: Phil makes a speech to Dianna Counter. Dianna and Midgard depart from Ameria on a ship. A sick Poe searches for the Willghem. Harry confronts her and gives her medicine. The Red Team spots Dianna. The Willghem flies into the clouds since the Moonrace is afraid of lightning. Cancer and Muron of the Red Team catch up to Midgard and Dianna and they head to the ship Gendarme. Loran and the others fight off Poe.

episodes.title: The King of Myth
episodes.synopsis: The Willghem reaches Manupichi through which they believe they can make it to space. Upon their arrival they find that Dianna Counter already occupies it. Joseph is from the area and says the Adeskan people live in Manupichi. An Adeskan girl named Mayalito believes the Turn A Gundam to be a white devil. Loran and the others encounter her and Quoatl, king of Adeska who says their people saw a vision of a nucelar blast. He agrees to help Loran after they fight and tells them of their legend of the Ades branch. Guin plans to fire the Willghem's mega beam cannon if Loran and the Suicide Squad can't take Manupichi by morning. Another Adeskan named Taruka confronts them, and everyone is thrown in a dungeon.

episodes.title: Captured Manupichi
episodes.synopsis: Joseph meets up with Mayalito who doesn't believe Quoatl to be a cowardly king. The Adeskans demand Quoatl pick up a sword and fight Taruka, but he refuses. Joseph arrives and provides a distraction, and Quoatl finally fights Taruka. Quoatl had refused earlier challenges because Taruka wasn't ready to become king. Quoatl and Mayalito help attack the Dianna Counter soldiers while the Suicide Squad attacks their cannons. Kihel tries to stop the firing of the Willgehm's beam cannon. Planted bombs destroy the cannons, along with assistance from Taruka. Quoatl and Mayalito sacrifice themselves. Taruka becomes the new king and encourages Loran to head to space.

episodes.title: Flight into the Ozone Layer
episodes.synopsis: Midgard prepares the Gendarme to head to space. At Manupichi, the mass driver is revealed. Harry approaches the Gendarme in his Sumo but is unable to board it. Miran and Phil argue on the Soleil about what to do. The Willgehm prepares for takeoff, but Poe attacks. Loran fights them in the Turn A Gundam and is helped by Harry. The Willgehm takes off, and is helped by the Turn A Gundam and Sumo, making it to Sacktrager in space.

episodes.title: Zacktraeger
episodes.synopsis: The Willgehm docks with Sacktrager. The Gendarme is also docked there. Harry gets on the Willgehm and despite some of the crew's hesitancy speaks with Kihel. Midgard sends out forces to attack the Willgehm. Harry, Loran and Sochie try to trick Midgard and sees that he is using Dianna as a shield. Harry is able to install surveillance on the Gendarme. Dianna and Kihel speak to Midgard's pilots and are able to stop the attack on the Willgehm. The Gendarme and Willgehm both depart Sacktrager and head for the moon.

episodes.title: The Militia`s Space Battle
episodes.synopsis: Michael, Yanny and other members of the Militia are having a hard time getting used to space. Sochie and Kihel spend some quality time together. Yanny and other soldiers get drunk and try to return him to earth in a barrel forcing Loran to rescue him. Michael and Yanny then take Kihel hostage on the bridge, thinking she is Dianna. By sucking the air out of the bridge, they are forced to relent, but flee to the mobile suit deck where they take out to Borjanons and a Kapool. Loran and Harry go out to get them back.

episodes.title: The Moon Gate
episodes.synopsis: Cancer overhears Midgard plotting with Gym Ghingnham on killing Dianna. She and Muron try to rescue Dianna, heading out on a FLAT and a shuttle. Loran and Sochie ponder where to put the Turn A Gundam's hidden nuclear bombs. Dianna, Cancer and Muron head to the asteroid colony Mistletoe and send a signal to the Willghem. Loran decides that he will hide the nuclear bombs there. Gym discovers that Dianna is at Mistletoe. He launches a force led by Sweatson Stero. Harry heads off in his Sumo with Kihel. Loran and Sochie are attacked by Sweatson's forces and enter Mistletoe.

episodes.title: The Fighting God, Ghingnham
episodes.synopsis: Loran and Sochie are pursued by Sweatson and his Mahiroos, and Harry tries to stop them by saying he has rescued Dianna. Dianna, Cancer and Muron enter activate the asteroid's systems and fight off Sweatson's forces. They meet up with Loran, and Dianna convinces Cancer and Muron to trust him. Harry admits his love for Kihel and kisses her. The Willghem enters Mistletoe. Harry and Kihel meet up with Gym on the ship Aspite. Sweatson is given orders to attack. The Mahiroos try to lock the Willghem in Mistletoe, but everyone is able to escape before it is destroyed.

episodes.title: The Exploding Planet
episodes.synopsis: The Willghem continues to depart from Mistletoe. Sweatson and his Mahiroos attack again. Guin speaks with Midgard, and Gym agrees to negotiate and get Agrippa involved. Part of Mistletoe is set to crash into Von City on the moon. Kihel demands Gym destroy it; he initially claims he doesn't have enough weapons, but then agrees to use the Turn X top. Loran plans to use the nuclear bombs stored in the Turn A Gundam to destroy the remains of Mistletoe. Gym recognizes the Turn A Gundam. Loran is successful in detonating the remains of the asteroid with the bombs. Cancer and Muron head back towards Earth in their FLAT.

episodes.title: Sea Battle Under the Moon
episodes.synopsis: The Turn A Gundam and Kapool enter the moon. There they find a giant river and Loran meets up with his friends Donna and Hammett, who ride dolphins. They head to their house, where a crowd is excited to see Dianna. Guin, Michael and Lily meet with Gym, who says that he's more focused on the military and they should speak with Agrippa. Midgard tries to stab Harry, to no avail. Dianna hopes to head to the Moon capital of Gaingnham and they wonder if they can get there via the river. Working with cloth, giant disguises are made for the Turn A Gundam and Kapool to make them look like whales. Sweatson's group arrives at the Moon and starts searching for them. The Aspite and Willghem descend to Gaingnham. Whales appear, enabling Loran and the others to repel Sweatson's attack.

episodes.title: The Decision to Fight
episodes.synopsis: Loran and the others head down an industrial elevator to Gaingnham where Dianna hopes to meet with Gym and Agrippa. They meet back up with the Wilghem. Through Lily, they have obtained a meeting with Agrippa. Harry rescues Kihel on the Aspite. Sweatson is restless and heads out to find the Turn A Gundam. Bruno brings the Willghem in the city where he uses the city as a shield. Guin, Dianna and the others head into the palace where Guin claims she is Kihel and they encounter Agrippa. Upon seeing the city under attack, Agrippa requests help from Gym. Guin returns to the Willghem, upset at how this hurt negotiations. Guin thinks about negotiating with Gym and Agrippa directly. Sweatson demands the Turn A Gundam be turned over or he'll kill Guin, Lily and Dianna, causing them to get upset at Agrippa. Loran wonders what to do.

episodes.title: Turn X Activates
episodes.synopsis: Midgard holds Dianne, Guin and Lily hostage. Michael announces that the Willghem will destroy the city if the Moonrace tries to take the Turn A Gundam. Agrippa asks Gym to make Sweatson's Mahiroos retreat. Gym decides he'll use the Turn X, and contacts his subordinate Merrybell Gadget. Sweatson and Loran fight each other. Harry and Kihel enter the city. Agrippa tells Loran that if he fights the Turn X on the Moon's surface, the hostages will be released. Loran accepts. Agrippa thinks that by going to Earth, Dianna has rekindled the fighting spirit in the Moonrace and that she must be eliminated. Gym uses the city's power to start the Turn X. Midgard tries to kill Kihel but is stopped by the arrival of Dianna and Harry, and Guin's efforts. Agrippa escapes. The Turn X and Turn A Gundam meet each other on the Moon's surface.

episodes.title: The Dark History`s Impact
episodes.synopsis: Gym tells Loran to hand over the Turn A Gundam, that it destroyed Earth's civilization and that he is protecting Dianna by destroying it. Merrybell joins in the battle on her Bandit. Gym is told that the Militia have taken Dianna's palace, but he doesn't care, leaving it up to Agrippa. Dianna, Agrippa and others head further underground where people are kept in cryogenic stasis. People are shocked when Dianna and Kihel reveal when they had switched places. Harry defends against an attack from Sweatson's Mahiroo squad. Dianna leads everyone into the Dark History room, which plays events from the past, including all previous Gundam shows, such as mobile suit battles and colony drops. Images of the Dark History start appearing throughout the area, including the city and the fight between Loran and Gym on the surface. Lastly, a video is shown of the Turn A Gundam using the Moonlight Butterly attack to destroy Earth's civilization.

episodes.title: The New Enemy
episodes.synopsis: People continue to watch images of the Dark History. Dianna orders Agrippa to have the battle on the surface stopped and for his spies to leave Dianna Counter. Agrippa is scared over what will happen now that the Dark History has been revealed. The citizens of Gaingnham start rioting, including outside of Dianna's palace. Loran continues his battle with Gym and Merrybell. Dianna and Kihel try to stab Agrippa, but Midgard shoots him instead. The Willghem picks up everyone. Sweatson attacks in his Mahiroos. Dianna is worried about the billion people in stasis in this area. Guin asks Sid to copy all the information about the Dark History. Loran arrives and helps fight off Sweatson's attack. The Gendarme also appears and joins in the attack. Midgard rushes to escape, but Harry kills him. Dianna makes a speech to calm down the populace.

episodes.title: Guin`s Betrayal
episodes.synopsis: Kihel visits Harry in the hospital, in Dianna's clothes. A group of people are released from stasis, including Teteth's mother. Guin, Michael and Sid look over the records of the Dark History and think about mass producing their own mobile suits. Gym meets with Dianna, but refuses to hand over his mobile suits. Merrybell tries to kill Dianna but Gym has her stop, not knowing if its really her and they leave. Guin meets up with them. Dianna wants Loran to steal the Turn X from Gym. Guin decides to align himself with Gym and orders the Willghem to head to Earth such that he can restore the Earth using Moonrace technology. Loran flees, taking the Turn A Gundam with him. Gym attacks him with the Turn X as he leaves, and Loran is forced to escape in the core fighter.

episodes.title: Back to Earth
episodes.synopsis: The Willghem meets up with the Aspite and they head for Earth. Bruno and Jacop fail in their attempt to escape. Loran returns to Dianna and the others in Gaingnham and they decide to return to Earth. More riots occur in the city and Dianna speaks to them once more about how she has to stop Gym, then everyone can return to Earth. Gym sends Zssan mobile suit forces to prevent Dianna from leaving. Harry and Loran work on defending against them. Afterwards, everyone boards the Almaiya and it takes off from the Moon.

episodes.title: Ghingnham Attacks
episodes.synopsis: Sweatson's Mahiroo squad attacks cities on the Earth. Keith and his wife are caught up in the attack. The Almaiya enters the Earth's atmosphere. Guin meets with Keith and Horace, desiring for the Moonrace's help. Mahiroos attack the capital of Luziana. The Almaiya arrives, meeting up with Joseph, Fran, Keith and others. Dianna hopes to destroy the Turn a Gundam but they must defeat Gym to do so. Guin makes an announcement, and asks Loran how he can hope to defeat Gym without the Turn A Gundam, while Loran demands the Willghem be returned to Dianna. The Mahiroos launch an attack, against Guin's orders. Merrybell joins in on the attack, piloting the Turn A Gundam. Harry and others fight them off, forcing the Willghem to retreat.

episodes.title: Dianna Returns to Earth
episodes.synopsis: Merrybell destroys a town with the Turn A Gundam's Moonlight Butterly system. Conflict arises between Guin and Gym since everyone in America now opposes Guin. Corin appears and tells them what Merrybell is doing. He bows before Dianna, willing to fight for her. Sweatson and his Mahiroo squad attack the Soleil. Dianna wants to join forces with Phil and Dianna Counter to defeat Gym. Loran, Sochie, Fran and Joseph go to the Willghem where they confront Guin. Bruno and Jacop escape from the ship. The Soleil and Almaiya attack. Joseph steals back the Turn A Gundam. The Soleil's crew gathers for Dianna, and Phil and Miran agree to follow her.

episodes.title: The Moonlight Butterfly
episodes.synopsis: Merrybell and Sweatson lead an attack on the Almaiya. Bruno and Jacop join up with Harry. Joseph continues to pilot the Turn A Gundam and he fights Loran over it. Gym is angry that Guin lost the Turn A Gundam. Corin heads out to fight in a Kapool and joins Poe in fighting off Merrybell and Sweatson. Gym heads out in the Turn X. Harry also heads out in his Sumo. Joseph fights the Turn X but it starts drawing the Turn A's energy. Gym kills Sweatson when he interferes. Harry, Poe and others arrive and damage the Willghem then try to hold the Turn X in place. Gym activates the Moonlight Butterfly. Loran docks his core fighter with the Turn A Gundam and prepares for one final battle with Gym.

episodes.title: The Golden Autumn
episodes.synopsis: Poe and Harry join up with the Soleil. Sochie and Miashei help out Corin with his Kapool. The Almaiya discovers the Turn A Gundam's location. The Willghem descends to the ground and Michael says he'll no longer follow Guin's orders. Loran fights Gym, who wants to use the Turn X to destroy civilization and begin things anew. He starts a Moonlight Butterfly attack. Corin fights off Merrybell, but is killed by Gym's attack. Loran activates the Moonlight Butterfly as well. The abandoned Guin rescues Merrybell and join up with Michael and Yanny. Sochie joins up with Harry and Poe in defending the Soleil, which activates its barrier. Loran slices into the Turn X, and Gym ejects the Turn X top. The two get out of their mobile suits and fight with swords. Gym is enveloped in a sealing light from the Turn A and Turn X while Loran is able to escape due to Sochie's help. With Gym permanently trapped, the war ends.

info.title: Best Student Council
info.synopsis: Randou Rino ha perso sua madre un anno fa e da allora è rimasta sola. I suoi risparmi stanno finendo ed è costretta a fare affidamento sul suo amico di penna, il signor Poppitt. Quest'ultimo si offre di sistemare Rino in una nuova scuola e in un nuovo appartamento, ma le cose sembrano un po' strane. Che tipo di liceo ha le Divisioni Segrete e d'Assalto nel consiglio scolastico?!

episodes.title: Dear Mister Popitt
episodes.synopsis: Thanks to the mysterious penfriend Mr. Poppit Rino Rando is attending Miyagami School, accompanied by her sarcastic puppet Pucchan. She finds out the apartment organised for her has burnt down, so she heads up to the school. She ends up sleeping outside after she gets frightened by a bear in the bushes and another student, Kaori Izumi, who turns out to be her class president. Rino ends up trying for a position on the Student Council so she can get somewhere to live (they're given an apartment building to live in), and by a series of accidents on the way to the Student Council building manages to defeat the arsonist who burnt down her apartment, thus ending up on the best student council!

episodes.title: Surging With Youth
episodes.synopsis: The council throws a welcoming party for Rino (What about the budget?!) as the school is jealous over Rino being put on the Best Student Council on her first day.

episodes.title: Payapaya in the Gokujou Dorms
episodes.synopsis: Rino is on the Best Student Council, which comes as a shock to nearly the whole school and many of the students can't understand why Rino made it onto the Best Student Council. She's not the brightest, failing her tests miserably, or good at sports. Not to mention the fact that she's clumsy. So what does she bring to the group? Why did the President of the Best Student Council pick her? Because of this, rumors start to fly about Rino and the President. Those opposed to the President's decision are upset and in disbelief. The Paparazzi Club, the Photography Club, and the Newspaper Club all team up to find out just what's going on.

episodes.title: A Brilliantly Clear-Headed Way
episodes.synopsis: The puppet theater is sabotaged; Rino and Pucchan investigate.

episodes.title: Spectacular Showdown
episodes.synopsis: The budget is overextended and a culinary battle between the Assault and Covert squad is staged to decide who gets the next month's financing.

episodes.title: A Great Terror! Pucchan's Curse
episodes.synopsis: The Best Student Council calls out against Rino for badmouthing them with Pucchan so they confiscate the offensive little puppet to force her to reflect on her habit. This becomes a tale of Pucchan's revenge against members of the council that doubt his puppet power. The student council learns the hard way that simple Rino wasn't lying when she claimed that Pucchan was a separate person entirely.

episodes.title: We Love to Help Out
episodes.synopsis: Mayura Ichikawa, the best student council's treasurer who is usually stressing out about the school budget, requests a day off. Mayura is spotted sneaking off campus, all gussied up. The best student council wasn't going to get involved until it is discovered that Mayura is going on a date, and the couple was spotted heading towards the red light district.

episodes.title: Farewell! Best Student Council
episodes.synopsis: Exams are coming up and it just wouldn't be acceptable for any best student council member to fail. Reno, Rein, and Cyndi are one step away from failing so they'll all have study night and day with the help of the other best student council members to pass. Will they be able to pass their exams?

episodes.title: Love Never Ends
episodes.synopsis: Sayuri is attacked by a mysterious girl who also practices the way of the sword. Who is she? And what does she have against Sayuri?

episodes.title: She Won't Put On Her Swimsuit
episodes.synopsis: Summer and swim season is just around the corner. Nanaho and the best student council plot ways that the students can go swimming without getting spied on by boys from nearby schools.

episodes.title: Winning Five
episodes.synopsis: The Miyagami Academy futsal team is sick with a cold. Unfortunately, they have a game scheduled against the Kenran Academy, who consider themselves to be Miyagami's rivals. So the best student council decides to play in place of their team to protect the school's reputation. How good will the girls be at futsal?

episodes.title: It Happened on a Rainy Day
episodes.synopsis: The girls start to wonder why President Kanade is always gone on the third Sunday of each month. Kuon decides to have the Covert Squad find out what the President is up to. Nanaho reflects upon the day she first met Kanade.

episodes.title: Is Minamo-chan an Enemy or an Ally?
episodes.synopsis: Kanade and Nanaho return to the best student council dorms to find them virtually destroyed. Rino tells them the destruction of the dorms is a short story which begins when Rino met a girl named Minamo.

episodes.title: Destitution Student Council
episodes.synopsis: The best student council decides to put on a play, titled "The Alien Space Creature from Outer Space" written by Minamo, to raise money. Will their play be a financial success?

episodes.title: The Reason I'm Here
episodes.synopsis: The girls are able to return to their dorm rooms. When they return they find a mystery photo of a man in Kuon's room. They now wonder if they need to protect her just like they did for Mayura. During the investigation of the mysterious man in the photo Kuon's secret motive for attending Miyagami academy.

episodes.title: È estate! Tutti al campo scuola
episodes.synopsis: Rino and Minamo force covert squad member Kotoha to let them "help" her with her missions.

info.title: A Terrified Teacher at Ghoul School!
info.synopsis: Haruaki è timido e ha paura di tutto e di tutti, ma cerca comunque di essere un buon insegnante. Tuttavia, la nuova scuola in cui sta per iniziare a lavorare non è esattamente come se l'aspettava: i suoi studenti, infatti, sono mostri, demoni, fantasmi e ogni sorta di creatura soprannaturale!

episodes.title: Welcome to Hyakki Academy!
episodes.synopsis: A loser teacher, Haruaki Abe, starts his new position at a school filled with youkai called Hyakki Academy. He then goes to visit a shut-in zashikiwarashi named Beniko so everyone can be included in the class picture.

episodes.title: Physical Exams Are Life-Threatening?!
episodes.synopsis: Hyakki Academy is in a panic because of the upcoming physical exams. Haruaki has trouble doing the cyclops Rensuke's eye exam and getting the daidarabocchi Oota's height. But further misfortune falls upon him as he's also tasked with cleaning the pool...

episodes.title: Panic! In Miki-sensei`s Youkai Studies Class!!
episodes.synopsis: Haruaki is invited to observe Miki's youkai studies class but things immediately get hectic when Miki decides to demonstrate his powers by having a little bit of sake...

episodes.title: An Interview with Haruaki?! Here Comes Youkai TV!
episodes.synopsis: Youkai TV wants to do an up-close-and-personal interview with Haruaki?! Of course, he has trouble during an extracurricular lesson and his students try to make him look good but it fails! Will this thing actually air?

episodes.title: I Know. Let`s Go to Sensei`s Family Home.
episodes.synopsis: Haruaki goes back to his family home, but then a few of the students decide to visit him there. While they're there, the students meet Haruaki's older brother, Amaaki, who seems to dislike youkai.

episodes.title: Sports Day at Ghoul School!! Commences
episodes.synopsis: It's Sports Day at Hyakki Academy! A scavenger hunt relay, mandragora toss... plenty of youkai-themed events! A fiery battle over Class 2-3's victory and Haruaki's xxxx begins now!

episodes.title: Sports Day at Ghoul School!! Finishes
episodes.synopsis: It's Sports Day at Hyakki Academy part 2! Class 2-3 is struggling at 3rd place, but they're trying to get to 1st place with the obstacle course relay. But an accident occurs and steers the event into an unexpected direction.

episodes.title: Amaaki, Momoyama-san, and the Nudity Festival
episodes.synopsis: Amaaki, Haruaki's twin brother, takes his place and becomes a teacher for a day. Soon after, Yanagida's love potion cause havoc at the school. And to finish the episode off, the whole class goes to a public bath.

episodes.title: Save Me, Seimei-kun! The Case of the Animal Youkai Abductions!!
episodes.synopsis: Numerous cases where animal youkai are getting abducted and having their fur shaved off occur! Mamekichi, Tamao, and Hatanaka also disappear so Haruaki and Sano try to save them. Will Haruaki be able to save his furry friends in this mysterious case?

episodes.title: School Camp of Terror
episodes.synopsis: This episode involved a huge event: a school camp! Or rather, it ended up being a final exam for spookology. Can the students safely get through the old school building and the various trials that await?

episodes.title: Parent-Teacher Conference from Hell!
episodes.synopsis: Haruaki does some parent-teacher conferences, but of course, the parents are also youkai, so they don't go very smoothly. On the way home, he scouts Kyoto with Miki and Hatanaka for a future school trip but then they all remember a certain incident...

episodes.title: The Great Tokyo Haruaki Search!!
episodes.synopsis: Kaminarimon and Tokyo Tower! Class 2-3's excitement over their Tokyo field trip comes to a sudden halt when Haruaki gets swept away by a wave of salarymen into the subway and gets lost. The students split up to find him but Sano gets a really bad feeling.

episodes.title: The Cursed Secondhand Book
episodes.synopsis: Summer vacation is finally here! Hijita and Rensuke enjoy Beniko's special shaved ice, while Mamekichi and Tamao go catch some bugs. Meanwhile, Haruaki goes to a bookstore where Sano works and is recommended a book but that ends up causing havoc!

episodes.title: Zashiki-san`s Bed-and-Breakfast Home
episodes.synopsis: During the middle of summer vacation, Beniko's family home that's a bed and breakfast is going to be featured in an occult magazine. Beniko and her friends work together to spook the scientist that the reporter brought along to disprove her home being supernatural.

episodes.title: Abe no Seimei, Haruaki Abe, and Shutendouji
episodes.synopsis: Summer vacation still continues! Haruaki is invited to Miki's family home in Mount Ooe. There, he finds out Rintarou's dark past and ends up having to fight a great enemy.

episodes.title: The Great Hyakki Academy Island Chase!!
episodes.synopsis: Officer Yamazaki, the doppelganger police officer of Hyakki Academy Island, tries to protect the peace by capturing a teketeke robber.

episodes.title: Summer! The Ocean! Huh? It`s Already August 31st...
episodes.synopsis: Class 2-3 enjoys some time at the beach during their summer vacation and Haruaki and Sano learn about youkai births.

episodes.title: The Temporary Teacher, Ebisu-sensei
episodes.synopsis: A new teacher named Ebisu-sensei, who is a god of fortune, comes to teach at Hyakki Academy for a short time.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Youkai Train
episodes.synopsis: Haruaki and some of the kids in Class 2-3 take the train to go shopping but there's something off about the train.

episodes.title: The Night Parade Cultural Festival
episodes.synopsis: The Night Parade Cultural Festival at Hyakki Academy begins!

episodes.title: The Underground Night Parade Cultural Festival
episodes.synopsis: Haruaki goes with Tamao to get some equipment for the cultural fair but something goes wrong.

episodes.title: Goodbye, Ren-Ren
episodes.synopsis: Nyuudou suddenly announces that he's leaving school so Haruaki and the class try to stop him.

episodes.title: The Gashadokuro, Kuniko Utagawa
episodes.synopsis: Haruaki and his class continue their efforts to get Nyuudou back and Utagawa reveals a secret about herself.

episodes.title: The Bond Continuing with Ren-Ren. The Teacher from Ghoul School Will Do His Best!
episodes.synopsis: Haruaki and his students continue to do their best to get Nyuudou back.

info.title: From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated!
info.synopsis: Kenzaburo Tondabayashi è un impiegato pubblico di cinquantadue anni che un giorno si ritrova coinvolto in un incidente stradale. Al suo risveglio si rende conto di essere finito in un otome game nei panni di Grace Auvergne, la figlia del duca e antagonista del gioco. Non volendo rovinare i lieto fine dei vari personaggi che lo circondano decide di continuare ad interpretare il ruolo del cattivo, però i ricordi della sua vita passata come affettuoso genitore e la sua difficoltà a ricordarsi tutti quei fastidiosi nomi stranieri rendono il suo obiettivo più difficile di quanto sembri...

episodes.title: Dad Becomes a Villainess
episodes.synopsis: Kenzaburo Tondabayashi is a staunch, 52-year-old bureaucrat until he seemingly dies in a traffic accident! He then finds himself reincarnated into the world of the Otome game.

episodes.title: Dad Becomes a Sorcerer
episodes.synopsis: It is only proper that Kenzaburo commits himself to Grace’s villainous role in the original story. Unfortunately, decades of learned habits are difficult to break.

episodes.title: Dad Makes a Pun!
episodes.synopsis: Grace, aka Kenzaburo, integrates himself into the student council. He may be an effective bureaucrat, but his resourcefulness and modesty are raising unnecessary love flags.

episodes.title: Dad Summons a Beast
episodes.synopsis: The day the students' familiars hatch arrives at long last. Meanwhile, in another world, two women must come to terms with the fate of a beloved husband and father.

episodes.title: Dad Gets Into Dual-wielding
episodes.synopsis: Impressed by a rare accomplishment, the principal asks Grace aka Kenzaburo to participate in the Magic Exhibition.

episodes.title: Dad Is Moved to Tears
episodes.synopsis: Grace and Anna have both proven their worth time and time again. Unfortunately, there are those who insist on sowing division between them.

episodes.title: Dad Puts On an Exhibition
episodes.synopsis: Grace’s father returns after a business trip, but proves he doesn’t know his daughter very well. However, as a fellow father, Kenzaburo understands that the man is trying.

episodes.title: Dad Becomes a Maid
episodes.synopsis: Grace aka Kenzaburo invites Anna to stay at the Auvergne estate over the summer when it becomes clear she still needs to learn the ins and outs of high society.

episodes.title: Dad Gets Trapped
episodes.synopsis: When the student council gets trapped in a labyrinth, it's up to Grace aka Kenzaburo and Anna to save everyone.

episodes.title: Dad Cross-dresses
episodes.synopsis: Grace aka Kenzaburo goes incognito to visit the bakery that Anna's family runs, but Anna's mother quickly deduces Grace's identity.

episodes.title: Dad Gets Into an Elegant Pickle!
episodes.synopsis: The student council decides to put on a gender-swapping play with Anna in the lead role! Unfortunately, Anna overworks herself to the point of collapse.

episodes.title: Dad Celebrates at the Campus Festival
episodes.synopsis: The Elegance Cheat has a fatal flaw: Grace aka Kenzaburo can't perform without everything becoming unnecessarily fancy!

info.title: The Poem of Wind and Trees (ITA)
info.synopsis: La storia è ambientata nella Francia della fine del XIX secolo; Serge, di indole calma e gentile, è un ragazzo religioso che viene mandato dalla famiglia a studiare in un collegio dove si troverà a condividere la stanza con Gilbert, bello, biondo e con una condotta di vita dissoluta. Basato sul manga di Keiko Takemiya.

info.title: Ladyspo
info.synopsis: La commedia fantascientifica segue tre di cacciatrici di taglie, Arigetti, Korpi e Sabina, le quali gareggeranno in svariate discipline sportive. Arigetti eccelle in mille sport, Korpi possiede un gran “senso del gioco”, Sabina ha la capacità di “leggere l’avversario”.

info.title: Lupin III - La pagina segreta di Marco Polo (ITA)
info.synopsis: In seguito a una dritta ricevuta da Fujiko, Lupin parte alla ricerca una lastra di ardesia andata perduta sulla quale sarebbe incisa parte del racconto de Il Milione, che conterrebbe gli indizi per ritrovare il leggendario tesoro di Marco Polo. Contemporaneamente però il professor Theo Argent, studioso della storia dell'esploratore veneziano, viene assassinato e i sospetti cadono proprio su Lupin. Braccato dalla polizia e da vari malintenzionati, dovrà risolvere il mistero con l'aiuto di Lisa, la nipote del deceduto professore.

info.title: Iria: Zeiram The Animation
info.synopsis:
La storia di I.R.I.A - Zeiram the Animation è ambientata su Myce e comincia con Iria, apprendista di suo fratello maggiore Gren, bounty hunter esperto, e del suo partner Bob, che lavora per la Ghomvak Security, insieme al rozzo Fujikuro. Durante una missione, all'interno della nave spaziale Karma, il gruppo si trova faccia a faccia con il malvagio e indistruttibile alieno Zeiram, che ha distrutto l'astronave e sterminato l'equipaggio. Bob viene ferito gravemente da Zeiram, mentre Gren sparisce nel nulla.

Ritornati su Myce, Iria scopre di essere diventata l'obbiettivo di un gruppo di assassini al servizio della Teden Tippedai, la corporazione che possedeva la nave Karma. Iria scopre che dietro la tragedia della Karma si nasconde un terribile esperimento della Teden Tippedai, che ha intenzione di usare Zeiram come arma. Iria, Fujikuro e Bob, ridotto ad un corpo artificiale, decidono di investigare sulla natura di Zeiram e su cosa è accaduto a Gren, che sembra essere ancora vivo.

Ogni episodio contiene tre brevi storie: un antipasto, un piatto principale e un dessert. I primi due piatti di ogni episodio descrivono gli eventi spettrali che ruotano attorno alla scolaretta di sesta elementare Ako Oozora. L'ultimo capitolo di ogni episodio è una storia di fantasmi raccontata da Ako e i suoi compagni di classe.

episodes.title: First Campaign
episodes.synopsis: In the year UC 798, or IC 489, the Iserlohn garrison fleet led by Admiral Attenborough encounters a huge Galactic Empire formation during a patrol mission in the Iserlohn Corridor. The Alliance ships were transporting a large number of new recruits who were supposed to have their space training there. Outnumbered, the Alliance command has no choice but to send out young and still unexperienced conscripts against well-trained Imperial forces. Julian, who was assigned to the flagship of the squadron as a Spartanian pilot, must now face his first real battle.

episodes.title: Movie 2
episodes.synopsis: Mittermeyer’s sense of justice has unleashed the wrath of Duke von Braunschweig, one of the most powerful men in the Empire. He may now be executed without going through military court. Fearing the worst, Reuenthal turns to Reinhard to save his best friend.

episodes.title: Movie 3
episodes.synopsis: When the massive Geiersburg Fortress suddenly materializes in the Iserlohn Corridor, Caselnes immediately forwards a request for reinforcements to Heinessen, but now he must prepare for the imminent Imperial attack. Meanwhile, in Heinessen, Frederica is desperately looking for allies to save Yang.

episodes.title: Reformer
episodes.synopsis: After becoming the highest military and political figure in the Empire, Reinhard starts to implement a series of major reforms, introducing a taxation system for the aristocracy and restoring freedom of speech. His policy creates both new hopes and great discontent. But Yang quietly wonders what the birth of a reformed Galactic Empire with strong popular support is going to mean for the future of the Free Planets Alliance.

episodes.title: The Geier Takes Flight
episodes.synopsis: The head of the Galactic Empire's Science and Technology Department, Anton Hilmer von Schaft, is a man known for his sheer ambition. He is now presenting to Reinhard a large-scale plan to retake the long-lost Iserlohn Fortress.

episodes.title: A Single Fine Thread
episodes.synopsis: The planet Fezzan is an autonomous dominion located in one of the only two safely navigable zones that connect the Galactic Empire and the Free Planets Alliance. Every Fezzani head of state, or Landesherr, has protected the independence of the dominion by maintaining strong ties with both its much more powerful neighbors. However, the current fifth Landesherr, Adrian Rubinsky, also known as the Black Fox of Fezzan, seems intentioned to change this long-standing policy.

episodes.title: What Was Lost
episodes.synopsis: Hilde has convinced Ernest Mecklinger, who is known in the Empire as the "artist admiral," to pay a visit to her cousin, Baron Kümmel. Prone to illness and forced to stay in bed, Kümmel is a man with a penchant for great historical figures, and he strongly admires Mecklinger's brilliant mind and great skills. While Hilde is delighted to see a spark of happiness finally shining in her cousin's tired eyes, her assignment as chief secretary is about to cause her much greater concerns.

episodes.title: The Inquiry
episodes.synopsis: A sudden recall order from the central government of the Free Planets Alliance forces Yang to head for the capital planet Heinessen. Yang assigns the command of the Iserlohn Fortress to Caselnes and von Schönkopf, and departs aboard the cruiser Leda II with minimal personnel, including his second-in-command Frederica and his guard, Machungo.

episodes.title: Movie 3
episodes.synopsis: When the massive Geiersburg Fortress suddenly materializes in the Iserlohn Corridor, Caselnes immediately forwards a request for reinforcements to Heinessen, but now he must prepare for the imminent Imperial attack. Meanwhile, in Heinessen, Frederica is desperately looking for allies to save Yang.

episodes.title: Fortress vs. Fortress Akt I: Cannon Fire
episodes.synopsis: Admiral Kempff, Commander-in-Chief of the Geiersburg Imperial expeditionary force, sends a peremptory declaration of war to the Alliance garrison of Iserlohn. Then Geiersburg's main gun suddenly opens fire with devastating results. On Iserlohn, a confused Caselnes and his officers do not seem to agree on the best strategy to take...

episodes.title: Fortress vs. Fortress Akt II: Fierce Fighting
episodes.synopsis: The Imperial fleet relentlessly conducts their assault on the Iserlohn Corridor, one blow after another. As Caselnes is still struggling with organizing an effective resistance, Imperial armored infantry units have landed on Iserlohn, and threaten to establish a bridgehead. Then, former Imperial admiral Merkatz, who defected to the Alliance, asks to be assigned temporary command of the garrison fleet.

episodes.title: Fortress vs. Fortress Akt III: The Return of the Magician
episodes.synopsis: An Alliance relief fleet is finally heading to the Iserlohn Corridor, but combat forces on the battlefield are limited, and a wrong move could turn fatal. Should the Iserlohn garrison fleet be unable to break the blockade imposed by Kempff's ships, the reinforcements from Heinessen would be easily destroyed. On the command bridge of Iserlohn, Caselnes and his officers animatedly discuss the countermeasures, but what sounds like the best plan comes from somebody most unexpected.

info.title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity (ITA)
info.synopsis: La Chidori High è una scuola maschile prevalentemente frequentata da studenti di bassa estrazione sociale e con voti pessimi; la Kikyo Girls' High invece è una scuola femminile che ha come studentesse le figlie di famiglie ricche e prestigiose. Queste due scuole, che sono situate una di fianco all'altra, sono in continua disputa fra loro. Rintaro Tsumugi è uno studente del secondo anno della Chidori dall'aspetto da delinquente, ma dal carattere gentile, che un giorno, mentre sta aiutando nella pasticceria di famiglia, incontra Kaoruko Waguri. I due vanno subito d'accordo anche perché Kaoruko non sembra dare importanza all'aspetto del ragazzo, ma questa sensazione di pace viene rapidamente turbata quando Rintaro scopre che la ragazza frequenta la Kikyo. Questa rivelazione segna l'inizio di una faticosa storia fra i due, mentre lottano contro le limitazioni imposte dalle loro scuole e dall'ambiente circostante, nel tentativo di trovare la loro strada.

info.synopsis: Il professor Sasaki, stanco e sopraffatto dal lavoro, una notte resta sorpreso da un evento inspiegabile: gli armadietti degli studenti si trasformano in misteriosi pannelli di scelta. Per gioco seleziona una ragazza che cattura la sua attenzione, convinto di trovarsi in un sogno. Ma poco dopo lei appare davvero in aula, lo rimprovera con tono aspro, mentre nei suoi occhi traspare un misto di imbarazzo e desiderio. Da quel momento Sasaki viene trascinato in un rapporto ambiguo e proibito, dove il confine tra realtà e fantasia si fa sempre più sottile.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Room of Guilty Pleasure
episodes.synopsis: Mamoru Sasaki, a teacher who works overtime and gets dissed by his students, hears a mysterious announcement in school at midnight. The voice welcomes him to the Room of Guilty Pleasure, where he can pick any student he likes. Assuming that it's just a dream from the situation spread out before him, Sasaki picks one student on a whim. Led by the announcement, he enters a classroom where his sassy student, Mai Hoshino, is waiting for him, looking embarrassed...

episodes.title: Would You Like to Request a Girl With Glasses?
episodes.synopsis: After finishing his supplementary classes, Sasaki Mamoru works overtime until late at night. He is dozing off when the bell rings and wakes up, only to find himself face to face with "Guilty Hole" once again. "Which girl would you like to go with today?" Sasaki asks nervously, but chooses Takajo Makoto, the class representative. In response to Sasaki's sincerity, Takajo says, "As a thank you for listening to my advice..." and begins to button her uniform.

episodes.title: Congratulations on Unlocking the Option
episodes.synopsis: "Congratulations on unlocking the option! We have a reverse nomination today." Sasaki Mamoru can't hide his confusion as a different message than usual comes on the air. Light spills out from his Guilty Hall membership card, and he is transported to the audiovisual room. Waiting for him there is a beaming Hojo Makoto. The letters NN are written on the blackboard. This is a dream world. As his student Hojo stares at him, Sasaki, his homeroom teacher, can no longer contain himself...

episodes.title: Would You Like a Dark-Skinned Gyaru?
episodes.synopsis: While being concerned about a certain student of his, the exhausted Mamoru Sasaki was dozing off. He finds that he had fallen asleep as the usual announcement from Guilty Hole welcomes him yet again to the dream dimension. In the nurse's office, Sasaki gets a massage from Aya Hinata, who tells him to loosen up. As he is moved to tears by her kind words, she gently hugs him...

episodes.title: A Delivery from Guilty Hole!
episodes.synopsis: Mamoru Sasaki gets a notification from Guilty Hole while asleep in bed at home. The doorbell echoes down the hallway, and as he opens the door, he sees Aya Hinata standing there, stepping into his room with no hesitation. As she lifts up her skirt to seduce him, he reflexively turns his back. What could possibly go wrong with a man and a woman in an enclosed space...?

episodes.title: You Have Been Selected
episodes.synopsis: Thanks to the consecutive weird dreams, Mamoru Sasaki has successfully built some trust between his homeroom students. He ends up recalling the dreams during class because they were so vivid, and reproaches himself. However, it's not just Sasaki who's been having the dream, but Mai Hoshino and Aya Hinata as well. The coming day, Hoshino runs up towards Sasaki on impulse as she sees him being friendly with another student, while Hinata witnesses the scene out the window.

episodes.title: Would You Like a Blond-Haired Gyaru?
episodes.synopsis: The students were getting excited about the coming school festival, only to have it cancelled due to the chairman's decision. Mamoru Sasaki, feeling disappointed and irritated at being useless, gets forcibly flung into the dream by the Guilty Hole that appears before him. In the dream, Mai Hoshino was waiting for him at school. She interrupts Sasaki's depressed talk and kisses him, leaning in and baring her breasts...

episodes.title: Would You Like to Select All?
episodes.synopsis: A moment of relief after successfully convincing the chairman cuts short for Mamoru Sasaki, when he ends up becoming the school festival's representative. Just when he falls asleep, more exhausted than ever, Guilty Hole notifies him that he has been selected. In the dream, the school festival was being held, and awaiting Sasaki were Mai Hoshino, Aya Hinata, and Makoto Hojo in maid outfits! As his three students gaze up at him with puppy-dog eyes, willingly serving him as a token of thanks for looking after them, Sasaki was finally able to enjoy his dream...

info.synopsis: La storia è incentrata su Konomi Inori, una studentessa del primo anno delle scuole medie che si è appena trasferita nella città di Onegai. Nella piazza della città, Konomi prega davanti alla statua della dea chiedendo di avere la possibilità di diventare una AiPri. Dopo aver pregato, incontra per caso la famosa AiPri Aoi Yumemiya e il suo misterioso peluche parlante di nome Fortu. Si scopre che Fortu è alla ricerca di una AiPri capace di realizzare il suo desiderio e, quando Konomi apre lo speciale “mirror pact” che Aoi le ha consegnato, ottiene il debutto come AiPri che aveva tanto desiderato.

episodes.title: Please! Become an AiPri
episodes.synopsis: Inori Konomi is a first-year middle school student who loves "AiPri"! "Please give me a chance to become an AiPri!" Inori prays to the goddess statue in the town square, when she coincidentally meets Aoi, a popular AiPri...

episodes.title: Let`s Make That Dream Come True
episodes.synopsis: Inori begins her life in Onegai Town. When she enrolls in Onegai Middle School, Aoi is in the same class. After school, Aoi takes Inori to Meganee's cafe in Onegai Town. There, Fortune asks Inori to join the "Wish-Fulfilling Squad," which grants the wishes of the people of Onegai Town. The first person Fortune receives a wish from is Koharu, an upperclassman at the same school. What could Koharu's wish be...?

episodes.title: A Single Beloved One
episodes.synopsis: Inori and Aoi are in the same class, the Tomosaka group. One of them says she's lost a sticker she cherished. She asks them to help find it, and they begin their search...

episodes.title: My Friend Is an AiPri!?
episodes.synopsis: Inori and Aoi, on an errand for Meganee-san, arrive as requested. When they enter the Western-style confectionery shop they were looking for, they find Gumi there. Patisserie Tomosaka is Gumi's family business. After watching Inori and Aoi's live performance, Gumi tells them how amazing it is, and Inori asks, "Why don't you try AiPri?" But Gumi shakes her head, saying it's impossible. For the next few days, Gumi leaves school early after classes. In fact, she had been secretly training to become an Aipri without telling Inori and Aoi. Inori wants to see what she's doing...

episodes.title: The First AiPri Fest!
episodes.synopsis: Inori's grandfather is the town's mayor. He prays to the goddess statue, saying, "I want to make this a town full of smiles." Hearing this, Inori proposes the "Wishing Town AiPri Festival."

episodes.title: Connect! Love and Dreams
episodes.synopsis: Today, it's a sleepover at Aoi's house. Inori and Gumi are excited, but the serious Aoi says she wants to have a debriefing session about the AiPri Festival. The festival was a success, but she wants to be able to perform for even more people. Aoi tells the two of them about her aspirations. As a result of the debriefing, they come up with two goals: "to fill the plaza with customers" and "to try a new type of live performance." After dinner, Aoi's older sister, Wakaba, comes home. Wakaba, who is in the track and field club, is happy because she ran with her friends and set a new record. Hearing this, Gumi says she wants to see Inori and Aoi's live performance...

episodes.title: Both Their Wishes
episodes.synopsis: The Wish-Fulfilling Team received two requests. The first was from Satsuki. She was worried because she had injured herself during club practice, but her friends were saying it was "nothing serious." The other was from Aoi's older sister, Wakaba. She was worried because she wasn't in good form, even though a track and field competition was coming up. Gumi decided to support Satsuki, while Aoi and Inori decided to support Wakaba. The Wish-Fulfilling Team worked hard to fulfill both of their wishes, but...

episodes.title: What I Wanted to Say
episodes.synopsis: Inori and the others thank Olivia, the student council president, for helping to make the AiPri Festival a success. However, Olivia seems very busy with the student council's "Flower Planting Campaign." Gumi brings Olivia some baked goods to cheer her up as she works hard alone. Olivia became student council president at someone's request. She's also working hard on the "Flower Planting Campaign" all by herself, thinking of everyone. But deep down, she wishes she could have fun doing it with everyone. When Gumi hears this, she...

episodes.title: With Wings of Courage
episodes.synopsis: Olivia visits the AiPri Shop alone. Seeing how much Olivia knows about AiPri's, Mega-nee asks her, "Do you want to become an Aipri?" Just then, Inori and the Wish-Fulfilling Team, along with Koharu, arrive at the shop. Olivia quickly leaves the shop as if she was running away. Koharu had wanted to talk to Olivia about the next AiPri Festival. Meanwhile, Olivia still worries about lying to Koharu, saying that she didn't know much about AiPris, even though she actually wanted to become one. At that moment, a request arrives from Koharu to Inori and the others: "I want courage..."

episodes.title: Little Friends
episodes.synopsis: Something is wrong with Olivia's younger brother, Leon. Leon is found in the schoolyard with lots of bread. This morning, Olivia's portion of bread was gone. Worried, Olivia begins searching for Leon.

episodes.title: Inori`s Treasure
episodes.synopsis: Inori's birthday is fast approaching. Inori invites Aoi and the others to her birthday party. She sets off to find a venue. Aoi, Gumi, and Olivia visit Inori's grandparents to give her a present. As they try to find out what Inori likes, Aoi and the others learn that every time Inori returns to Onegai Town, she prays to the goddess's statue, "May I always be good friends with my best friends." Determined to make it the best birthday party ever for Inori, Aoi and the others are excited. However, on the day of the party, the weather is unfortunately rainy...

episodes.title: Gumi and Olivia
episodes.synopsis: Koharu wants Olivia's live performance to be the main event of the upcoming second AiPri Festival. Gumi encourages her to do it, but Olivia refuses, saying she's not confident.

episodes.title: Soar High! AiPri Fest!
episodes.synopsis: The second annual AiPri Festival is finally about to begin. Even more customers have gathered than last time, and Inori is excited and in high spirits. However, Olivia is trembling uncontrollably from nervousness.

episodes.title: My High Sense!
episodes.synopsis: The second AiPri Festival has ended, and the Wish-Fulfilling Squad is full of energy with Aoi as their new leader. Then, a wish arrives from Kanata, a student at High Sense Academy. Kanata says she entered High Sense Academy with the dream of becoming a fashion designer, but has now given up. She had prayed to the statue of the goddess, "May I find my true dream." Just then, Atami Nana, also from High Sense Academy, appears. Nana urges Kanata, "Don't rely on anyone, figure it out on your own." Hearing this, Gumi tries to find Kanata's "true dream"...

episodes.title: The AiPri of Passion
episodes.synopsis: From the Atami family mansion, figures can be seen gazing out at Onegai Town... It's Atami Nana, her brother Sango, and their butler, Hyozan. Sango asks, "Nana, if you become an AiPri, do you think you can grant someone's wish?" Nana decides to become an AiPri. At the same time, Shioki and Koike from the Onegai Middle School student council are making a wish to the goddess. They are lamenting that they can't get their hands on a watermelon and won't be able to make everyone happy during their summer off-campus volunteer activity. Inori and Aoi perform a live show to cheer them up. Just as Shioki and Koike regain their motivation, Nana appears before them...

episodes.title: The Top Power of Passion
episodes.synopsis: Inori and her friends are looking forward to summer vacation. Nana has performed many live shows, but has yet to successfully perform a Buzzrium Change. Just then, a request arrives. It's from Olivia's younger brother, Leon. Leon is depressed because he has angered his friend Manabu by not getting a perfect score on a test. Gumi performs a live show to help them make up. Nana watches them and tries to achieve a Buzzrium Change with her own passion...

episodes.title: Aoi and the Wish Granting Squad
episodes.synopsis: Summer vacation has begun. On her way to Meganee's cafe, Inori hears a rumor from Moko that there's a ghost on the beach. Inori suggests that the Wishing Squad go and look for it. However, Aoi refuses, saying she has summer homework to do. Nana then joins them and asks Aoi, the leader, "What do you want to do with the Wishing Squad from now on?" Aoi is troubled and can't answer immediately. Just then, they spot a ghost on the beach! Or so they think, but it turns out to be a dejected Fumika...

episodes.title: Emma Can See It
episodes.synopsis: Gamu and Choco want to make the next AiPri Festival a success, so they start building a huge sandcastle on the beach. Just as it's almost finished, they go home to get the flag they'll put on top. When they return to the beach with Gumi, they find the sandcastle has been swallowed by the waves and collapsed. Dejected, Gamu and Choco end up fighting. Inori and Aoi perform a live show to cheer up Choco. Meanwhile, Emma appears before Gamu, who has made a wish: "I hope I can build a sandcastle with Choco again." It turns out that Emma was the one who advised him to make the wish. What exactly is her aim...?

episodes.title: The Mysteries of Onegai Town
episodes.synopsis: After seeing Nana's passionate live performance, Megane's older sister was filled with emotion and embarked on a three-day summer vacation. During that time, Nana's butler, Hyozan, was put in charge of acting store manager. Inori and the others also decided to help out at the store. Thanks to Nana's publicity, many customers came, and the Wish-Fulfilling Team was full of energy. --And then Shioki arrived. Shioki, along with Ema, ​​belongs to the "Wish Town Mystery Research Society." She had wished to see the "Midsummer Blue Jewel," which is said to be only visible during the summer. Taking her wish to heart, Ema took to the stage for the live performance.

episodes.title: Clash! Courage and Passion!
episodes.synopsis: The 3rd AiPri Festival is fast approaching. The day before, Sango's "High-Sense Festival" will be held. It seems to be a variety show featuring talk segments, games, and prize giveaways, with the super-popular talent "Tate Goto" making an appearance. Nana suggests that she perform the final live show of the AiPri Festival to liven up the event. However, Olivia argues that Nana's performance is only worthy of being at the top. The two girls' relationship becomes strained... Nana challenges Olivia to a live show showdown...

episodes.title: Fortu Will Explain It All-chu
episodes.synopsis: The town of Onegai, a seaside town that sparkles and shines in the sunlight. In the town square stands a statue of a goddess, and it is said that if you make a wish to the goddess, that wish will come true. Inori and Aoi met in front of that statue. That was the beginning of the miracles that would unfold in Onegai Town. This special episode looks back on the many events that have occurred since Inori and Aoi met, together with Forchu.

episodes.title: Dokidoki! Summer Fest Showdown
episodes.synopsis: The day of the showdown between the AiPri Festival and the High-Sense Festival has arrived. The High-Sense Festival is buzzing with excitement thanks to Tate Goto's sweet poetry. But then, as if to drown out the excitement, Nana appears, instantly raising the energy of the AiPri Festival. Then, Inori and Aoi appear. Their duo performance sends the audience into a frenzy. This is followed by Emma's solo, and then a duet by Aoi and Gumi. The AiPri Festival and the High-Sense Festival are neck and neck in terms of excitement so far. Which one will win?!

episodes.title: It`s Goodbye
episodes.synopsis: Summer vacation is over and second semester begins. Nana came to Onegai Junior High School where Inori and her friends were.. Nana asks her to find Emma, ​​who is also a student at the Hisense Academy she attends.. When I looked into it, it appears that he has submitted a transfer notification.. Nana forms the Onegai Detective Team with Inori and Aoi to investigate Emma's whereabouts.. During Gumi and Oribia duo live, Nana and her friends discover Emma carrying a large bag.. Emma said, ``Please, I have to leave town.''.

episodes.title: The Whereabouts of the Letter
episodes.synopsis: Inori's friend, Mai-chan, has come to Onegai Town. Inori gives her a tour of Onegai Town. Mai-chan, a huge fan of AiPri, is thrilled to meet Inori, Olivia, Gumi, Emma, ​​Nana, and Aoi. She is also very happy to see Nana and Emma perform live. Another thing she wanted to do in Onegai Town was to meet her pen pal, Ayaka-chan. Inori and the others begin searching for her together. However, they discover that the picture book store where Ayaka was supposed to live moved a week ago...

episodes.title: The Little Ghost`s Wish
episodes.synopsis: Rumors spread that a girl ghost haunts AiPriverse. Emma, ​​a member of the "Mystery Research Club," is fascinated by ghosts. Just then, a request arrives from AiPriverse. Inori and the others immediately head to I-Priverse. There, they meet the three members of the AiPri Club: Riori, Azumin, and Kyoka. Riori and the others say that the request was made by a ghost. Just then, the rumored girl appears before the Wish Granting Team!? And what is the ghost's request...?

episodes.title: Let`s Pop On!
episodes.synopsis: Inori prays to the statue of the goddess, "Please let me meet the goddess soon." To make the "miracle of the goddess" happen, they must start walking towards a new dream. To do that, Inori and the others realize they need to fulfill many more wishes and begin special training. Nana comes up with ideas like taiyaki-themed outfits and poetry, but Gumi objects, saying, "I think something's not right." Their opinions clash, and the two girls fall apart. Left alone, Inori feels anxious. To make matters worse, she receives news that her grandfather has been hospitalized...

episodes.title: Six Wishes
episodes.synopsis: To perform a miracle, they must overcome the "Goddess's Trial." The team of three, Inori, Gumi, and Nana, has decided on the name "Smile Heart" and is full of enthusiasm.

episodes.title: Convey It! Pure Heart
episodes.synopsis: Autumn is the season for art. An art festival is being held at the Wish Square, and it's a huge success. Inori, Gumi, and Nana are enjoying themselves. However, Aoi, Olivia, and Emma are anxious to make their trio live performance a success as soon as possible. Emma and the others know their own personalities, that they are too cautious and can't act quickly. They decide to think together about what the three of them need right now. But they can't seem to find an answer. Just then, Aoi and the others receive a request from Shioki and Koike, who are participating in the art festival...

episodes.title: Teach Me Your Love
episodes.synopsis: Emma wants to perform the "Goddess's Miracle," but feels she still isn't trying hard enough. Meanwhile, Inori wants to become closer to Emma, ​​who, along with Aoi and the other girl, has deepened their bond and successfully held a Pure Heart live performance. Inori immediately goes to see Emma. Emma is anxious because she needs to collect the Wish Prisms. However, she is moved by Inori's enthusiastic desire to "get to know Emma better!" and the two end up playing together...

info.title: The Ghost in the Shell
info.synopsis: Nell'anno 2029, Niihama City è una metropoli tecnologicamente avanzata dove i cittadini possono sostituire i propri arti con parti robotiche, e la Sezione 9 della Pubblica Sicurezza combatte corruzione, terrorismo e altre minacce nate dalla globalizzazione. La Maggiore Motoko Kusanagi guida un caso che coinvolge un misterioso hacker noto come il "Puppet Master", che lascia dietro di sé vittime private dei ricordi e possiede un corpo quasi interamente robotico dai poteri straordinari. Mentre Motoko segue le tracce del criminale, l'ingerenza di altre parti in causa, tra cui la Sezione 6, rivela la natura estremamente complessa del caso, e riflettendo sul senso della propria esistenza la Maggiore capisce presto che l'unico in grado di darle risposte è proprio il Puppet Master.

episodes.title: Prologue / Super Spartan I
episodes.synopsis: During a raid on a meeting with a foreign representative that he suspects involves corruption and criminal activity, Public Security's Daisuke Aramaki encounters a mysterious cyborg. Introducing herself as Motoko Kusanagi, the cyborg proposes the formation of a new special forces unit to the Minister of Internal Affairs. Aramaki asks Kusanagi to investigate something as a first step.

episodes.title: Super Spartan II / Junk Jungle I
episodes.synopsis: Kusanagi and her team begin operating as the Shell Squad after being scouted by Aramaki. At some point, the cyberbrain of the Foreign Minister's interpreter was infected by a virus. Aramaki senses that Col. Malles, who is living in exile in the country, is trying to interfere with a secret meeting. He orders Kusanagi to back-trace the hack and find the culprit.

episodes.title: Junk Jungle II / Megatech Machine I / Megatech Machine II
episodes.synopsis: Kusanagi and Togusa take their suspect into custody after a furious chase in their Fuchikomas. Elsewhere, Aramaki and Batou are staking out Col. Malles when he is paid a visit by someone they suspect is the Puppet Master, the hacker who released the virus on his orders.

episodes.title: Robot Rondo
episodes.synopsis: There has been a rash of attacks against humans by promotional sample robots. Kusanagi's team rounds up robots of that same model line, and they learn that they all share a common trait. Batou and Togusa head to Hanka Precision Instruments, where they are made, to determine what is behind the attacks.

episodes.title: Phantom Fund
episodes.synopsis: Kusanagi and the team go to the Far North to surveil a combat cyborg named Koil Krasnov. To determine what Koil is after and uncover corruption behind the expansion of Sagawa Electronics' underground factory, Kusanagi infiltrates Sagawa's offices while Batou and the rest make for the underground factory.

episodes.title: Dumb Barter
episodes.synopsis: Kusanagi and her boyfriend are rushed to the hospital after being attacked without warning. They suspect Toru Soma, a terrorist that Kusanagi has a history with. Kusanagi and Togusa leave the hospital, and after leading their pursuers on a chase, they find themselves in a fierce battle against an armed group in an abandoned factory.

episodes.title: Bye Bye Clay
episodes.synopsis: A robot flees from Megatech Body Co., Ltd. Section 9 takes it into custody, only to find that the Puppet Master is inside it. The Puppet Master announces to Aramaki's team that it is "a life form that arose spontaneously in the sea of information." Moments after it requests political asylum, it is stolen by an unknown party.

episodes.title: Intermission / Brain Drain I
episodes.synopsis: Kusanagi regains consciousness after a brain-dive into the Puppet Master. Although they now know the truth behind what happened, Kusanagi keeps sensing the Puppet Master's presence from time to time. The Shell Squad raids a boat being used by a terrorist cell, and Kusanagi mistakenly guns down its leader.

episodes.title: Brain Drain II
episodes.synopsis: Footage of the incident is leaked to the media by some unknown party, and Kusanagi is accused of murdering the terrorist in cold blood. Kusanagi, suspecting that the Ghorantl intelligence service is pulling the strings behind the scenes, conducts a solo investigation, but she finds herself put on trial.

episodes.title: Brain Drain III / Ghost Coast / Epilogue
episodes.synopsis: Kusanagi loses her prosthetic body when it is gunned down, and she flees the scene with Batou as a disembodied brain. They go to Batou's safehouse to get her a new body, but she is channeled into by the presumed-destroyed Puppet Master while in lockdown mode.

info.synopsis: "Contessa Romelia. Rompo il nostro fidanzamento". Queste furono le prime parole del principe Henri subito dopo aver sconfitto il Re dei Demoni. Al suo fianco c'erano la santa Elizabeth, la saggia Ekaterina e la spadaccina orientale Lu Hime... tutte quante la puntano con aria accusatrice definendola "inutile". Ma Henri e le sue compagne non sapevano che Romelia possedeva un potere miracoloso chiamato "Grazia", in grado di conferire fortuna a chi la circonda. Nonostante l'abbandono del fidanzato e delle sue compagne, Romelia non si è arresa. La sua terra natale è ancora infestata dalle forze del Re dei Demoni e molte persone sono tenute prigioniere e utilizzate come schiavi. Per salvarle la ragazza si è imbarcata in una missione piena di difficoltà: per prima cosa non aveva un esercito con cui combattere, non aveva nessun guaritore che potesse curare le ferite e le mancavano i fondi per finanziare tutto. Ma Romelia è determinata a risolvere ogni problema, non importa se dovrà usare le maniere forti. Risorgendo dalle ceneri, una nobildonna decaduta si erge per salvare l'umanità!
